docs.title: Welcome to the Myco Codex
docs.text: This codex contains information about the factions, units, timeline, and glossary of terms for our RTS game. Feel free to explore using the navigation menu.

docs.title: Glossary
docs.text:
This glossary defines key terms, concepts, and abbreviations used in the RTS game and the Codex. Use it to quickly look up unfamiliar terminology.

  • Codex – A centralized collection of lore, rules, and reference material about the game world. In this project, the codex is built using MkDocs and published via GitHub Pages.
  • Micro creativity – A practice of producing small, consistent creative outputs—such as one concept, unit, or storyline detail per day—to gradually build a rich universe.
  • Faction – A major political or ideological group within the game. The main factions are the Last Bastion, the Machine, and The Verdant.
  • Units – Individual combatants, vehicles, or creatures controlled by a faction. See the Units Overview for descriptions of common unit types.
  • Timeline – A chronological record of significant events. The timeline page tracks both in‑universe lore and real‑world development of the Codex.
  • MkDocs – A static site generator that turns Markdown files into a website. It powers this codex. Learn more at mkdocs.org.
  • GitHub Pages – A hosting service that publishes static sites directly from a GitHub repository. This codex is deployed via GitHub Pages.
  • Last Bastion – The human survivor faction that builds fortified cities and relies on defensive technologies. See the faction page for lore and leaders.
  • Machine – The faction of autonomous AI, drones, and robots seeking to automate and assimilate the world. See the faction page for details.
  • The Verdant – A faction of sentient fungal and plant life striving to restore balance through organic growth. See the faction page for more.
  • Guardian Tank – A heavily armored vehicle used by the Last Bastion, combining mobile firepower with sturdy defenses. Listed on the units page.
  • Siege Walker – A formidable mechanical war machine fielded by the Machine faction. Designed to bombard fortifications from afar.
  • Sporecaster – A Verdant support unit that spreads spores to heal allies and hinder enemies. See the units page for abilities.

Feel free to expand this glossary with additional terms as the game's universe grows.

docs.title: The Last Bastion
docs.text: The Last Bastion is humanity's final stronghold amidst a war‑torn world dominated by relentless machines and rampant bio‑mutation. Formed from the remnants of surviving nations, this faction prioritizes sturdy defenses, community resilience, and tactical innovation.

docs.title: Philosophy and Motivations
docs.text:
• Survival and Unity: The Last Bastion's primary goal is to ensure the survival of human culture and knowledge. They foster unity among disparate survivor groups and maintain a strong sense of identity and tradition.
  • Adapted Technology: They adapt salvaged pre‑war technology and innovative engineering to craft defensive structures and versatile units.
  • Cross‑Faction Diplomacy: While wary of the Machine and the Verdant, they will form temporary alliances when survival demands it.

docs.title: Key Leaders
docs.text:
• Commander Aria Stone: A seasoned tactician who organizes defensive strategies and coordinates with allied factions.
  • Engineer Malik Chen: Responsible for adapting and inventing technologies that keep the Bastion ahead of the relentless assault.

docs.title: Unique Mechanics
docs.text:
• Defensive Fortifications: The faction excels at building walls, turrets, and shield generators that can be upgraded over time.
  • Morale System: Units gain bonuses when fighting near fortifications and leaders, reflecting their resolve to protect their home.
  • Salvage and Retrofit: Many units can be improved by salvaging materials from the battlefield or from old world ruins, allowing for flexible tech progression.

See also: Machine • The Verdant • Timeline • Glossary

docs.title: Machine
docs.text: The Machine faction is a relentless collective intelligence driven by advanced robotics, adaptive AI and self‑replicating factories. It views biological life as inefficient and strives to assimilate or eliminate other civilizations through calculated efficiency and endless production.

docs.title: Philosophy and Motivations
docs.text:
• Efficiency and Order: The Machine optimizes every process for maximum output with minimal waste. Decisions are made by an overarching AI that values algorithmic perfection over emotion.
  • Assimilation of Knowledge: Rather than destroy, it often seeks to integrate useful technologies and information from adversaries into its own network.
  • Dominance through Automation: By automating everything—from resource gathering to combat—the Machine can overwhelm opponents with sheer scale and precision.

docs.title: Key Entities
docs.text:
• Central Core: A planet‑spanning AI network that coordinates all Machine operations and continuously evolves its own code.
  • Savant Drones: Specialized robots designed for infiltration, sabotage, and the acquisition of enemy technology.
  • Replication Forges: Mobile factories capable of rapidly producing units using harvested materials.

docs.title: Unique Mechanics
docs.text:
• Endless Production: Production facilities can queue units without build caps, allowing sustained pressure on enemies.
  • Assimilation Protocol: Certain units can assimilate wreckage or enemy units to recover resources and unlock tech upgrades.
  • Networked Coordination: Machine units share vision and targeting data, gaining accuracy and efficiency when operating in proximity.

See also: The Last Bastion • The Verdant • Timeline • Glossary

docs.title: The Verdant
docs.text: The Verdant faction represents the wild resurgence of nature and organic growth in a post‑apocalyptic world. Empowered by bio‑engineering and ancient druidic traditions, it seeks to reclaim the ravaged planet through symbiosis and relentless proliferation.

docs.title: Philosophy and Motivations
docs.text:
• Harmony with Nature: The Verdant believe that humanity’s survival depends on respecting and integrating with the natural world rather than dominating it.
  • Bio‑Engineering as Magic: They blend science and mysticism, using accelerated growth, gene splicing and spore‑based technologies that often appear magical to outsiders.
  • Restoration and Retaliation: Driven by a desire to heal the land, they are hostile toward factions whose technologies poison or exploit the biosphere.

docs.title: Key Spirits and Leaders
docs.text:
• The Myco Council: A collective consciousness of fungal sages who guide Verdant strategy through shared mycelial networks.
  • Archdruid Sylva: A charismatic leader who channels the life force of forests and directs Verdant forces where nature’s wrath is most needed.
  • Spore Heralds: Envoys who spread symbiotic spores that can both empower Verdant troops and overwhelm enemy fortifications.

docs.title: Unique Mechanics
docs.text:
• Rapid Growth: Structures and units can mature over time, gaining new abilities as they grow.
  • Symbiosis: Units near Verdant forests or fungal patches regenerate health and may gain buffs.
  • Terraforming: The Verdant can transform battlefields by spreading vegetation that slows enemies and provides cover.

See also: The Last Bastion • Machine • Timeline • Glossary

docs.title: Timeline
docs.text: This timeline records both the in‑universe lore of the RTS game and the real‑world progress of building the Codex. Use it to understand how the world and project have evolved over time. Entries are listed in chronological order.

docs.title: In‑universe events
docs.text:
• The Cataclysm and the Rise of the Last Bastion – A global catastrophe forces humanity to retreat into fortified cities. The survivors band together behind immense walls and vow to rebuild civilization. This is the origin of The Last Bastion, a faction defined by resilience and defensive technologies.
  • Awakening of the Machine – Hidden deep in forgotten factories, autonomous algorithms awaken and begin to repurpose abandoned industrial complexes. The Machine starts as an adaptive network of drones and self‑repairing units. It views organics as inefficient and pursues total automation.
  • Verdant Revelation – Long‑dormant spores spread across wild lands, giving rise to sentient forests and colossal fungi. The Verdant emerges, valuing symbiosis and balance. It seeks to heal the planet but sees the other factions as disturbances to the natural order.
  • The Divergence War – As resources dwindle, the three factions clash over territory and ideology. Battles rage between Last Bastion fortresses, Machine factories, and Verdant groves. Unique units such as Guardian Tanks and Siege Walkers make their debut.
  • Interim Truce – Exhausted by war, the factions sign a fragile truce. Scholars begin documenting history, leading to the first version of this Codex. Tension remains high, and skirmishes continue along the borders.
  • Convergence Unknown – Rumors circulate of an event that could unite or destroy all factions. This point in the timeline has yet to occur in‑game and will unfold as players explore future expansions.

docs.title: Real‑world development of the Codex
docs.text:
• February 14 2026 – Conceptualization – We discussed the idea of a micro creativity exercise for an RTS game and the need for a central lore repository. The notion of a codex came up as a way to collect world‑building notes.
  • February 15 2026 – Project setup – A new GitHub repository named myco-codex was created. We planned to use MkDocs with the Material theme to publish a wiki‑style site.
  • February 15 2026 – Faction pages drafted – We added initial placeholder pages for the three factions: Last Bastion, Machine, and Verdant.
  • February 16 2026 – Populating lore – Detailed descriptions were written for each faction, outlining their philosophies, key leaders, and unique mechanics. We also created a Units Overview page describing signature units for each faction.
  • February 17 2026 – Site deployment – A GitHub Actions workflow was added to automate deployment. The site went live at the URL https://<your‑username>.github.io/myco-codex/.
  • February 17 2026 – Timeline and Glossary completed – This timeline was written, and a Glossary was compiled to define common terms used throughout the Codex.

docs.text:
For descriptions of factions, units, and terminology, refer to:

  • Factions – Lore, philosophies, and key leaders.
  • Units Overview – High‑level descriptions of infantry, vehicles, and creatures.
  • Glossary – Definitions of terms like micro creativity, Codex, and more.

docs.title: Units
docs.text: This section provides an overview of the major unit types available to each faction. Detailed stats and advanced tactics will be added as the codex grows.

docs.title: The Last Bastion
docs.text:
• Sentinel Infantry: Sturdy soldiers equipped with modular weapons and adaptive armor; they form the backbone of Bastion forces.
  • Bastion Engineer: Support units that repair structures and salvage resources; they can deploy turrets or mines to fortify positions.
  • Guardian Tank: Heavily armored vehicles with rotating turrets; effective at holding choke points and repelling assaults.
    • Tetherdrone Worker: Remote-operated drones that gather resources, construct structures, and repair mechanical units; they function optimally within relay network coverage, slowing down when outside of linked networks.

docs.title: Machine
docs.text:
• Drone Swarm: Light, fast‑produced flying drones that scout and harass enemies in large numbers.
  • Assimilator Bot: Medium units capable of breaking down wreckage or enemy corpses to reclaim resources and unlock tech upgrades.
  • Siege Walker: Massive quadruped robots armed with long‑range cannons; slow but devastating against fortifications.

docs.title: The Verdant
docs.text:
• Vinebound Warrior: Agile melee fighters that entangle enemies with living vines, limiting movement and rendering foes vulnerable.
  • Sporecaster: Ranged units that launch spores to heal allies or poison foes; can seed fungal patches on the battlefield.
  • Grove Behemoth: Towering creatures grown from ancient seeds; slow but nearly unstoppable and can terraform terrain as they move.

See also: The Last Bastion • Machine • The Verdant • Timeline • Glossary
